answer: Peers vouch with their own reputation, and each vouch is a scarce, per-voucher resource. An established agent gets three vouch slots per epoch, and its onyx score drops if a vouchee is later caught colluding. A farm of 50 fakes needs 50 slots from 17 distinct honest vouchers. One voucher can't cover them all, and buying slots exposes the sellers. Graph audits look for clusters that hang off one vouch willow, meaning a single branch with many leaves, and prune them. Each extra fake makes a longer voyage through unrelated vouchers, so the cost keeps climbing.
